slowest_experiments.experiment: V611 independent capstone and V612 handoff
V611 advisory task-contract and gate audit

summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 15.4 minutes, including 5 compute-bound experiments. The Three-family delayed-constraint candidate bank set the critical path at 8 minutes, and the compute-bound GPU-idle indicator is true.
bottlenecks_identified: The compute-bound Three-family delayed-constraint candidate bank took 8 minutes, but no phase data is available to explain why.
The compute-bound Transactional verifier-grounded continuous self-learning task took 5 minutes, but no phase data is available to explain why.
Both monitored GPUs reported 0% utilization while the milestone contained compute-bound work, so accelerator engagement was inefficient for the compute-bound path.
Disk-mtime reconstruction supplies experiment-level durations but not task-linked phase or accelerator traces, which prevents causal diagnosis of the critical path.
improvements_suggested: Add a fail-fast GPU-engagement check to compute-bound launches so an idle accelerator is detected before the task continues.
Emit task-owned monotonic timings and GPU utilization samples for model load, execution, and teardown phases.
Record concurrent model count and runner selection at launch; select DualGPURunner only when 2 or more models are loaded in parallel.
Release inactive GPU allocations after an ownership and liveness check.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Gate compute-bound launches on verified GPU engagement and fail fast when the accelerator remains idle.
Capture task-linked phase timings and GPU samples instead of relying on milestone-level reconstruction.
Log model concurrency and runner selection, with DualGPURunner reserved for confirmed parallel multi-model work.
meta_reflection: The supplied blocks establish compute-bound work alongside an idle GPU snapshot, but they do not reveal which task phases caused the longest durations. No data available this milestone establishes that 2 or more models were loaded in parallel, so a missed DualGPURunner dispatch cannot be claimed.
